scripts.build-react: cd app && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:client:win: cd client && npm install && npm run electron:build-win
scripts.build:client:mac: cd client && npm install && npm run electron:build-mac
scripts.build:win: npm run build-server && npm run build:client:win
scripts.build:mac: npm run build-server && npm run build:client:mac
scripts.production:win: npm run build-server && npm run build:client:win
scripts.production:mac: npm run build-server && npm run build:client:mac
scripts.start:win: npm run build:win && cd client && npm start
scripts.start:mac: npm run build:mac && cd client && npm start
